correctness.rationale: The cubic 18-vertex LCF Pappus graph has 27 edges; its ordinary matching complex has 35,367 nonempty matching faces and 40-dimensional reduced rational H5 using supplied full mod-two boundary ranks and Euler χ~=-40. The submitted source correctly derives signed Lefschetz trace as the independence polynomial at -1 of admissible graph-edge orbits; independent finite code enumerated all 216 graph automorphisms (backtracking adjacency preserving), evaluated the orbit formula per element, found 11 cycle-profile types and trace multiplicities {-4:18,0:81,40:1,-1:36,1:12,4:32,-2:36}, agreeing with published full class function. Source uses a second direct oriented-simplex trace, examined in verify_pappus.py; correctness derives from Hopf trace and rational homology concentration rather than logs alone. All published values and invariant-zero are consistent.

value.rationale: A complete rational character can be mathematically valuable when unknown, but this same full 216-automorphism class function was already published with all profile values. Partitioning known profiles into thirteen conjugacy classes and deriving a subgroup invariant is a redundant table calculation without a new useful invariant.

limitations: The independent finite check did not recompute each large mod-two boundary matrix; exact rank routine and complete published homology theorem were inspected.
